description: Boost quiet audio up to 300% volume and export as WAV, with clipping detection.

faqs.a: Every sample is multiplied by your gain setting (100–300%). The tool counts how many samples clip and warns you.
Yes — the result shows the peak level and the number of clipped samples so you can lower the gain if needed.

howto: Drop an audio file into the tool.
Drag the gain slider from 100% to 300%.
Click Download WAV to save the boosted audio.
title: Audio Volume Booster
